name: aldia
description: Claude Code plugin that keeps your coding-agent setup up to date and lean.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('plugin/lib')) if (f.endsWith('.js')) fs.rmSync('plugin/lib/' + f)" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && node --test "dist/test/**/*.test.js"
